the real line at the same horizon
time on a yeast or fruit patch, generation zero

note: Generation zero does not find food better than a random walk would; it eats because its descending neurons drive the pharynx when it is on food, and the zeroed line starves because they do not. Whether selection improves on that is what the dish is for. Re-measured on every build by scripts/sim-gates.mjs.
